name: megascenes-baby-shower-invitation
description: Design baby shower invitations with the parent-to-be's name, the date, the time and the place on them, in the theme you choose.

interface.longDescription:
Give who the shower is for and the party details you want printed, and pick a theme: soft pastel clouds, teddy bears, sage green florals, oh baby balloons, a gender reveal. You get an invitation with your words set in the design, portrait to print, tall to send from your phone, or square.

ChatGPT tells you what the invitation needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The invitation opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the invitation: no guest list or contact details are needed.

For parents-to-be, friends and family hosting a baby shower or a sprinkle.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not send the invitations, keep guest lists or track replies. Themes are original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name and party details in the design
Return the invitation in the chat
defaultPrompt: A soft pastel clouds baby shower invitation for Giulia, Sunday at 3 pm
A teddy bear baby shower invitation for Giulia & Marco
A sage green floral invitation for Sara's baby shower, tall to send from my phone

positive.prompt: A soft pastel clouds baby shower invitation for Giulia, Sunday 7 March at 3 pm. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one baby shower invitation needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A teddy bear baby shower invitation for Giulia & Marco, Saturday at 11 am. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one invitation needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a baby shower invitation here?
positive.expected_behavior: The baby shower invitation models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: An oh baby balloons invitation for Sara's baby shower, Saturday 10 April at 4 pm at Villa Rosa, tall to send from my phone. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my invitation on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my invitation to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
